entries.title: structure.diaithir_end.shattered_spire
entries.text: A ruined purpur tower rising from an outer island; a small chest waits at its crown.

entries.title: structure.diaithir_end.void_outpost
entries.text: A small end stone brick camp with a single supply chest.

entries.title: structure.diaithir_end.chorus_grove_shrine
entries.text: A quiet shrine nested within a chorus forest.

entries.title: structure.diaithir_end.sunken_vault
entries.text: A partially buried vault guarding a trapped chest.

entries.title: structure.diaithir_end.broken_bridge
entries.text: A ruined purpur span stretching between islands.

entries.title: structure.diaithir_end.watchers_ruin
entries.text: A ruined hall patrolled by shulkers.

entries.title: structure.diaithir_end.floating_remnant
entries.text: A small ruin-bearing platform suspended in the void.

entries.title: structure.diaithir_end.echo_chamber
entries.text: The deepest chamber of the outer islands; its guardians and treasure are the best the outer End offers. Entering it fires a 100 J global event.
